public.text: The principle says contributors should gain value from the data they enter, which is important, but no design mechanism is suggested.
public.suggestedRevision: Add practical mechanisms such as reducing duplicate reporting, returning validated information to source systems, providing data-quality feedback, showing operational dashboards, and integrating reporting into routine workflows.
